minekit.dashboard.title: Minekit
minekit.overview.client_only: Runs only on your client. Servers and other players need nothing.
minekit.overview.key_conflict: %s uses %s, which is also bound to %s.
minekit.overview.config_read_only: The settings file could not be read. Changes apply only until the game is closed.
minekit.module.quick_actions.name: Quick Actions
minekit.module.quick_actions.description: Searchable popup for common Minekit actions.
minekit.quick_actions.title: Quick Actions
minekit.quick_actions.hint: ↑↓ select · Enter run · 1–9 pinned · Ctrl+P pin
minekit.quick_actions.how_to: Press %s for Quick Actions. Pinned actions come first, and the keys 1 to 9 run the first nine. Pin an action with the star in the list or Ctrl+P.
minekit.quick_actions.no_pinned: Nothing pinned yet. Pin the actions you use most.
minekit.quick_actions.hide_tooltip: Hidden actions are left out of the list. The search still finds them.
minekit.action.unavailable.no_held_item: Hold an item in your main hand first
minekit.notification.module_failed: %s could not start and is off
minekit.notification.quick_actions_disab: Quick Actions is off. Turn it on in the Minekit settings.
minekit.notification.action_failed: %s failed. See the log for details.
minekit.notification.save_failed: Settings could not be saved. See the log for details.
minekit.notification.config_recovered: Minekit settings were damaged and have been reset. A backup was kept.
minekit.notification.config_partial: Some Minekit settings were invalid and have been reset.
minekit.notification.config_read_failed: Minekit settings could not be read. Changes will not be saved.
minekit.notification.config_newer: Minekit settings are from a newer version. A backup is kept before saving.
minekit.module.smart_inventory.name: Smart Inventory
minekit.module.smart_inventory.descripti: Sorts your own inventory after showing a preview. Never moves items into containers.
minekit.sort.title: Sort inventory
minekit.sort.summary_hotbar_kept: %s slots change. The hotbar stays as it is.
minekit.sort.refused.cursor_not_empty: Put down the item on your cursor first.
minekit.sort.refused.oversized_stack: A stack is larger than normal (commands or mods). Sorting is off to keep it intact.
minekit.sort.favorite_hint: Click an item to mark it as favorite. Favorites come first.
minekit.sort.hotbar_hint_kept: Hotbar stays as it is. Click a box below it to choose.
minekit.sort.hotbar_hint: Boxes below the hotbar: what goes where. Click to change.
minekit.sort.preview_outdated: Your inventory changed. The preview was updated; check it and confirm again.
minekit.sort.totals_changed: Item counts changed during sorting. Please check your inventory and the log.
minekit.sort.blocked.player: you left the world or died
minekit.sort.blocked.game_mode: Not available in creative or spectator mode
minekit.hotbar.rule.any.description: The next item in sort order.
minekit.hotbar.rule.melee.description: Your best sword, spear, mace or trident.
minekit.hotbar.rule.food.description: The most filling food you have.
minekit.hotbar.rule.blocks.description: Your largest stack of blocks. Several block slots get different stacks.
minekit.hotbar.rule.utility.description: Buckets, ender pearls, rockets, totems and similar.
minekit.hotbar.rule.empty.description: Stays free for picking things up. Used only if the rest of the inventory is full.
minekit.executor.menu_closed: the inventory is no longer open
minekit.executor.stuck: no safe next step was found
minekit.executor.too_many_clicks: it took more steps than expected
minekit.inventory.how_to: Press %s in game or in your inventory, or use Quick Actions, to open the sort preview.
minekit.inventory.hotbar_kept: Sorting leaves the hotbar as it is. You can choose what goes in each hotbar slot instead, for example your best pickaxe in slot 2 and food in slot 9.
minekit.inventory.hotbar_reset_tooltip: Every slot back to “Leave as is”: sorting no longer touches the hotbar.
minekit.inventory.no_favorites: No favorites yet. Click an item in the sort preview to add one.
minekit.module.crafting_assistant.name: Crafting Assistant
minekit.module.crafting_assistant.descri: Calculates raw materials and crafting steps for any item and quantity.
minekit.crafting.title: Crafting Assistant
minekit.crafting.use_inventory: Use what is in my inventory
minekit.crafting.no_recipes: No recipes known. Join a world first.
minekit.crafting.choose_item: Choose an item on the left to see what it takes.
minekit.crafting.browse_hint: Search by name, or browse by category with the arrows above the list.
minekit.crafting.group_tooltip: Categories of the creative inventory. Click: next category
minekit.crafting.no_recipe_for_target: No recipe for this item is known to the client. It has to be found or traded.
minekit.crafting.warning.vanilla: %s step(s) use vanilla default recipes from the game files. The server may have changed them.
minekit.crafting.warning.cycle: %s would be made from itself; it is treated as a material to gather.
minekit.crafting.warning.fuel: Furnace steps also need fuel, which is not counted.
minekit.crafting.how_to: Plan what an item takes: raw materials, crafting steps and what is still missing from your inventory. Recipes come from your recipe book plus the vanilla defaults in the game files.
minekit.crafting.craft_it_tooltip: Craft this instead of gathering it
minekit.crafting.gather_tooltip: Gather this instead of crafting it
minekit.crafting.alternative_tooltip: Use another item of this kind
minekit.module.resource_tracker.name: Resource Tracker
minekit.module.resource_tracker.descript: Counts what you collect and use during a session, with goals and a HUD panel.
minekit.crafting.as_goals_tooltip: Add the missing materials as goals to the resource session (starts one if needed)
minekit.resources.goals_added: %s goal(s) added to the resource session
minekit.resources.no_session: No session is running. A session counts what you collect and use until you end it.
minekit.resources.rules: How Minekit counts: only item totals are compared, so moving items never counts. Gains with no screen open are "collected", losses are "used or given away". Changes while your inventory, a chest or another screen is open, in creative mode or when you die are "unclear", because their cause cannot be told.
minekit.resources.no_goals: No goals. Add the item in your hand, or use "Add as goals" in the Crafting Assistant.
minekit.resources.goal_from_hand: Add item in hand as goal (+64)
minekit.resources.unclear_explained: Changed while a screen was open (crafting, chests, trading) or in creative mode.
minekit.resources.name: Session name
key.minekit.loadouts: Loadout Manager (in a container: loadout panel)
minekit.module.loadouts.name: Loadouts
minekit.module.loadouts.description: Saves equipment and inventory arrangements and applies them with normal clicks, also from a chest.
minekit.module.storage_finder.name: Storage Finder
minekit.module.storage_finder.descriptio: Remembers what the containers you opened held, per world, and lets you search it.
minekit.module.smart_deposit.name: Smart Deposit
minekit.module.smart_deposit.description: Puts matching items from your inventory into the open container after a preview.
minekit.storage.unavailable.no_context: This world or server cannot be identified, so nothing is recorded
minekit.storage.forgot_all: All container records of this world were forgotten
minekit.storage.index_problem: The storage index of this world could not be read completely; see the log
minekit.storage.title: Storage Finder
minekit.storage.how_to: Open chests, barrels, shulker boxes, hoppers, dispensers or your ender chest. Minekit remembers their contents when you close them.
minekit.storage.limitation: Only containers you opened are known, as they were when you closed them. Contents may have changed since.
minekit.storage.page_intro: The Storage Finder only knows containers you opened yourself. Each world and server has its own index; records show how old they are.
minekit.storage.forget_all: Forget all containers of this world
minekit.deposit.title: Smart Deposit
minekit.deposit.open_container_first: Open a chest or another container first, then press %s
minekit.deposit.open_tooltip: Smart Deposit (%s): put items from your inventory into this container. You see a preview first.
minekit.deposit.profile.matching.descrip: Only items this container already holds.
minekit.deposit.profile.all.description: Every item that is not protected.
minekit.deposit.profile.resources.descri: Ores, ingots, gems, mob drops and similar materials.
minekit.deposit.profile.food.description: Food plus seeds, crops, saplings and bone meal.
minekit.deposit.profile.custom.descripti: The categories chosen on the Deposit page of the dashboard.
minekit.deposit.refused.cursor_not_empty: Put down the item on your cursor first.
minekit.deposit.refused.nothing_eligible: Nothing in your inventory fits this profile.
minekit.deposit.refused.container_full: The container has no room for these items.
minekit.deposit.done_partial: Deposited %1$s item(s) of %2$s kind(s); %3$s stayed with you because the container is full
minekit.deposit.totals_changed: Deposit ended with different item totals than expected. Please check your inventory and the container.
minekit.deposit.how_to: Open a container and press %s or the ⇩ button next to it. You see what would move before anything happens.
minekit.deposit.favorites_note: Favorites (set on the Inventory page) always stay with you unless you include them for one deposit.
minekit.deposit.include_favorites_toolti: Include your favorites in this deposit only
minekit.deposit.help.what: Puts items from your inventory into this container, with normal clicks.
minekit.deposit.help.profile: The profile picks the items. Matching: only what the container already holds, so each chest keeps its kind.
minekit.deposit.help.protected: Hotbar and favorites stay with you.
minekit.deposit.help.colors: Green: items go here. Amber: they come from here.
minekit.deposit.help.confirm: Nothing moves before you press Deposit.
minekit.loadout.title: Loadout Manager
minekit.loadout.full: You have %s loadouts, the most there can be. Delete one first.
minekit.loadout.totals_changed: Item counts changed while applying the loadout. Please check your inventory and the log.
minekit.loadout.save_tooltip: Saves what you carry and wear right now as a new loadout
minekit.loadout.name: Name
minekit.loadout.exact_tooltip: Only items with the same enchantments, name and other details count. Wear does not matter.
minekit.loadout.update_tooltip: Replaces the items of this loadout with what you carry and wear now. Locked positions stay locked.
minekit.loadout.empty_hint: A loadout remembers which item goes where: armor, offhand, hotbar and inventory. Put on your gear and arrange your inventory, then press Save inventory. Later you can apply it to put everything back in place, or take what is missing from a chest with the ⚒ button next to it.
minekit.loadout.grid_hint: Click: remove or lock · Shift-click: from inventory
minekit.loadout.no_room: %s position(s) stay as they are: no free slot for what is there now
minekit.loadout.extra: %s other item kind(s) stay where they are.
minekit.loadout.status.no_room: No free slot for what is there now
minekit.loadout.tooltip.click_item: Click: remove from loadout · Shift-click: what is here now
minekit.loadout.tooltip.locked: Locked: applying never touches this slot
minekit.loadout.tooltip.free: Free: applying may use this slot
minekit.loadout.tooltip.click_free: Click: lock · Shift-click: add what is here now
minekit.loadout.open_tooltip: Loadout: take what a loadout needs from this container
minekit.loadout.overlay_none: No loadout saved yet. Save one in the Loadout Manager (Quick Actions or dashboard).
minekit.loadout.overlay_explained: Takes from this container what the loadout still needs.
minekit.loadout.nothing_here: This container has nothing the loadout still needs.
minekit.loadout.overlay_rearrange: Takes nothing; only rearranges your inventory.
minekit.loadout.how_to: A loadout remembers which item goes where. Save your inventory in the Loadout Manager, then apply it later, or take what is missing from a chest with the ⚒ button next to it.
minekit.module.blueprints.name: Blueprints
minekit.module.blueprints.description: Imports .litematic and .schem files and shows them in the world as a building guide, with progress, materials and a measuring tool. Never places blocks.
minekit.action.blueprint_place_here: Place blueprint in front of me
minekit.blueprint.title: Blueprints
minekit.blueprint.open_folder_tooltip: The blueprint folder: config/minekit/blueprints. Files you put there appear in the list.
minekit.blueprint.drop_hint: Drop .litematic or .schem files onto this window
minekit.blueprint.choose: Choose a blueprint on the left, or drop a .litematic or .schem file onto this window. Minekit copies it into its blueprint folder; the original stays untouched.
minekit.blueprint.failed: %s could not be loaded. The message said why.
minekit.blueprint.not_placed: Not placed in this world yet.
minekit.blueprint.move_tooltip: One block; with Shift ten. X is east, Z is south.
minekit.blueprint.here_tooltip: Moves the blueprint in front of you
minekit.blueprint.remove_tooltip: Removes the blueprint from this world (the file stays)
minekit.blueprint.progress_after_placing: Place the blueprint to see what is built.
minekit.blueprint.next_none_loaded: Nothing missing in the loaded part.
minekit.blueprint.honest: Only loaded chunks are checked. Positions in unloaded chunks count as not loaded, never as built.
minekit.blueprint.unknown_blocks: %s block type(s) of this blueprint are unknown in this Minecraft version
minekit.blueprint.layer_down: Layer below (or scroll over the map)
minekit.blueprint.layer_up: Layer above (or scroll over the map)
minekit.blueprint.north_up: North is up, as it stands in the world.
minekit.blueprint.not_placed_map: Not placed yet: shown as saved in the file.
minekit.blueprint.materials_all: all, since it is not placed here
minekit.blueprint.goals: Add %s missing kind(s) as resource goals
minekit.blueprint.goals_tooltip: What you still need beyond what you carry becomes a goal of the resource session.
minekit.blueprint.without_item: %s positions hold blocks without an item (water, fire, …); they are not listed.
minekit.blueprint.how_to: Put .litematic or .schem files into the blueprint folder, or drop them onto the blueprint screen. Choose one, place it in front of you, and build: missing blocks glow teal around you, wrong ones red, the next one amber. Minekit never places blocks itself.
minekit.blueprint.none_active: No blueprint chosen. %s file(s) in the blueprint folder.
minekit.blueprint.limits_text: Files up to %s MB and structures up to %s positions are imported. Change maxFileMegabytes and maxPositions in config/minekit/blueprints.json.
minekit.measure.how_to: Look at a block and use Quick Actions → Measure: set point (or its key, unbound by default) for one corner, then again for the other. Minekit shows the box, its size and the distance.
minekit.measure.point_a: Point A: %s %s %s. Now set the other corner.
minekit.blueprint.error.file_too_large: the file has %s MB, the limit is %s MB
minekit.blueprint.error.too_complex: the data needs more than %s MB of memory or is nested too deeply
minekit.blueprint.error.not_compressed: this is not a compressed blueprint file
minekit.blueprint.error.not_nbt: the file is damaged or not a blueprint
minekit.blueprint.error.unknown_format: the file is not a Litematica or Sponge schematic
minekit.blueprint.error.legacy_schematic: old MCEdit .schematic files are not supported; save it as .schem or .litematic
minekit.blueprint.error.invalid_palette_: %s block types, at most %s are supported
minekit.blueprint.error.data_too_short: the block data of %s is incomplete
